themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe are intensifying calls for policies that prioritize nationals over immigrants in public services, housing, and employment. This theme reflects a shared transnational strategy to appeal to anti-immigration sentiments and reinforce nationalist agendas, appearing prominently in Spain, Italy, France, and Sweden.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Demands 'national priority' in Andalusia's housing policies, excluding non-nationals from social housing and public aid.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Advocates for stricter immigration controls and national preference in social benefits, aligning with EU skepticism.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Proposes policies to prioritize French citizens in welfare, housing, and employment, criticizing EU migration pacts.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Pushes for welfare and housing policies that prioritize Swedish citizens, citing integration failures.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Calls for 'Britain-first' policies, including stricter immigration controls and prioritizing nationals in public services.

themes.title: Javier Milei’s declining approval amid internal strife
themes.blurb: Argentina's President Javier Milei faces growing internal divisions within his party, La Libertad Avanza, alongside declining public approval. This theme highlights parallel political instability in far-right movements, with similar dynamics observed in the U.S. MAGA movement and Italy's Fratelli d'Italia, where leadership struggles and policy disputes undermine cohesion.

themes.title: Far-right gains in European local elections
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties made significant gains in recent local elections across Europe, consolidating their influence in municipal governments. This theme reflects a broader transnational trend of far-right electoral success, with notable victories in Germany, Italy, Spain, and Sweden, often at the expense of center-left and centrist parties.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Gains in local elections, including runoff victories in Saxony-Anhalt and Brandenburg, despite internal scandals.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Wins in mayoral runoffs in Macerata, Arezzo, and Lecco, reinforcing right-wing dominance in local governments.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Gains in Canary Islands and La Rioja, threatening PP's majority and reshaping regional alliances.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Increases influence in local councils, particularly in southern Sweden, amid rising anti-immigration sentiment.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Gains in local council elections, particularly in former Labour strongholds, signaling growing electoral relevance.

themes.title: Internal divisions within far-right parties
themes.blurb: Far-right parties across Europe and the Americas are grappling with internal divisions, often driven by leadership disputes, ideological fractures, or strategic disagreements. This theme highlights the fragility of far-right movements, with notable splits in Poland's PiS, Hungary's Fidesz, the UK's Reform UK, and Italy's Lega, threatening their electoral prospects and policy coherence.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Post-election splits between Orbán loyalists and Magyar's reformist faction, with accusations of corruption and authoritarianism.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Internal conflicts over Farage's leadership and councillor suspensions over past offensive remarks, undermining party unity.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Salvini's leadership challenged by Vannacci's Futuro Nazionale, with defections and policy disputes threatening coalition stability.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Le Pen and Bardella clash over pension reforms and wage policies, signaling generational and strategic divides.

themes.title: Far-right reactions to Middle East conflicts
themes.blurb: Far-right parties and leaders are increasingly framing Middle East conflicts through the lens of national security, immigration, and cultural identity. This theme reflects a shared transnational narrative that links regional instability to domestic policies, with notable reactions in the U.S., Argentina, Italy, Poland, and France, often blaming external actors for internal challenges.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
